name: landing-page-black-monorepo
description: Monorepo para Landing Page Black - Frontend (React/Vite) + Backend (Express)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix landing-page-black && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix ./backend && npm install --prefix ./landing-page-black && npm run build --prefix ./landing-page-black
